text:
Maria: Quick sync on Veridian pilot onboarding — I have a 3pm ET call with their eng lead. Posting live notes here.
- Enrollment: pilot MOU signed, onboarding started.
- SSO: waiting on IdP metadata from Veridian security team.
- Infra: smoke tests failing on GPU queue; seeing intermittent CUDA OOMs.
- Enablement: product demo tentatively 2026-04-01, need internal runbook.
- Feedback loops: they want weekly pulse survey + short recording reviews.
- Risk: compliance sign-off delayed, could push renewal convo.

Raj: I'll join the call. Can you paste the failing job id / logs? Might be batch config.

Maria: job id 8672, relevant log excerpt: ```ERROR: CUDA_OUT_OF_MEMORY at step 1024``` — repro on g4dn.xlarge only when seq_len > 2048.

Sophie: We can try reducing batch_size and enable kv-cache spilling for long sequences. I'll open a quick PR with suggested config.

Ben: Also propose offering a short Dedicated eval slot for the pilot (2-week trial) to stabilize perf — reduces renewal risk. @Elena can you price this?

Elena: I can ship a quote for a 2-week Dedicated eval by EOD. Also prepping an SSO checklist to send to Veridian.

Maria: For feedback capture — propose a 5-question Typeform + 15-min follow-up call each Friday. Metrics to track: avg token latency, request error_rate, and a small quality delta on our eval prompts.

Raj: I'll add a lightweight dash widget to the pilot org showing token_latency and error_count.

Sophie: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pilot-configs/pull/42 — changes: batch_size=2, kv_spill=true.

Maria: Action items:
- Raj: triage infra logs + run smoke with Sophie's changes by 5pm PT (owner: Raj) (due: today).
- Sophie: merge and validate; if green, enable in pilot org (due: today).
- Elena: quote for Dedicated eval (due: EOD).
- Ben: assemble enablement runbook + 4/1 demo agenda (due: tomorrow).
- Maria: send Typeform + schedule Friday feedback calls (due: tomorrow).

Ben: I'll run the first enablement dry-run at 11am PT tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued to pilot cluster: deploy/kv-spill-config-42 — started by Sophie — status: queued.

Maria: Flag: if compliance sign-off not received in 2 weeks, escalate and classify as renewal risk; will loop in AM and the AE.

Raj: On it. I'll post results from the smoke runs here.

Sophie: quick note — Veridian asked about data retention TTL; added doc link: https://redwood.internal/docs/data-ttl.

Maria: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
